g.text: Snow-loading nights, district by district: modelled automobiles as a share of places

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Each night from December 1 to March 31. If displaced cars can park anywhere in the district's part of the corridor, the night's loss of curb is the

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: share of the operation's truckloads hauled in the sector that night (loading assumed to proceed evenly over the sector).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Orange: curb alone. Green: curb and private places. Shaded: the share of the curb under a ban that night. Capacity, not occupancy.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Places: legal curb at 5.37 m (measured, upper bound) and private places of small buildings (measured). Automobiles MODELLED. Loading: City of Montréal,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: snow-removal transactions by sector and day; operations of ≥ 100 truckloads; spot removals left out. Loyola includes the Doug-Harvey free lot (20 places) in the winters it was listed.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Sources: SAAQ, vehicles released under the access Act (file 03.06.34729), December 31, 2024, type inferred; Statistics Canada, 2021 Census;

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: City of Montréal, géobase, parking-sign inventory and assessment roll (CC BY 4.0). Automobiles below the FSA are MODELLED, not measured.
